name: Lectro Components Inc
old_description: Since 1974, Your Single Source for HVAC, Controls, and Electromechanical Components.
about:
Lectro Components Inc was founded in 1974 in Bloomingdale, Illinois. The company has operated as a supplier of HVAC, controls, and electromechanical components for over four decades. No founders' names or ownership details are provided in the available materials.

The company serves as a single-source distributor and manufacturer of electronic and electromechanical components. Its product range spans HVAC components, circuit protection, relays, terminal blocks, transformers, cable and fiber assemblies, networking hardware, sensors, switches, and enclosures. The catalog includes authorized lines from brands such as ABB Entrelec, Littelfuse, Molex, Micron, and Marathon Special Products. The firm also offers cable assemblies and fiber optic assemblies, though the extent of in-house manufacturing is not detailed.

Lectro Components supplies industries including HVAC, industrial controls, electromechanical equipment, networking and telecommunications, and general electrical and electronic manufacturing. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to maintenance and repair operations seeking components such as DIN rail terminal blocks, control transformers, and fiber patch cords.

The company positions itself as a “single source” for a broad range of components, emphasizing breadth of inventory and authorized brand relationships. No specific founding mission or differentiation beyond product breadth is stated in the available materials.
